name: shva
description: Personal command + skill pack for Shiva. v0.1.0 shipped /shva:brief-me — domain-agnostic pre-project vocabulary briefing. v0.3.0 added /shva:shva-linkedin-post-writer — write LinkedIn posts in Dr. Shiva Kakkar's distinctive systems-thinker voice using the three signature lenses (Sequence Inversion, Constraint Migration, Authority Redesign), six-tier MCP source hierarchy (Readwise → Voicenotes → Plaud → Gemini files → LlamaCloud → Web), Hook Test and Cringe Test gates, and a god-mode end-to-end pipeline. v0.4.0 adds the Medium duo: /shva:shva-medium-writer (drafts a 1500-2000 word essay in Shiva's voice for shivakakkar.com, with Astro frontmatter + SEO/AI-SEO co-citation rules) and /shva:shva-medium-poster (publishes the deployed essay to Medium under 'Built at Rehearsal' via Chrome automation — state machine over import → cleanup → tags → submit-for-review, with cache-staleness detection and the full failure-recovery playbook from the 4-essay 2026-05-12 session). v0.5.0 promotes the LinkedIn anti-staccato cadence rule and the explicit LinkedIn MCP confirmation step. v0.6.0 adds /shva:worksheet-generator — turns a topic plus rough ideas into an AI-resistant, self-contained, print-ready teaching worksheet (HTML first, then a ReportLab PDF) in Shiva's voice via a 7-stage pipeline (AskUserQuestion intake; parallel research across LlamaCloud, the Obsidian wiki, Readwise, YouTube, book-search, and Mobbin design taste; a carried-forward content arc with one worked example; the hard formatting rules and contextual Be Mindful panels; an HTML house-style template with a render-and-eyeball loop; and a ReportLab build), bundling the aesthetic-pdf-creator guide, the worked builder, the HTML template, a banned-string lint, and a render-check script. v0.7.0 adds /shva:teaching-designer, the facilitator-facing sibling of the worksheet generator: it turns a teaching brief into a light, discussion-led executive keynote and an aesthetic interactive HTML doc (lesson plan plus click-to-expand spoken script). Discovery to research to converge to plan to HTML pipeline with parallel research and provenance and caveats, the scaled-spine arc (one idea across Individual, Team, Organization) with a running thread and a wrapper analogy, a named principle per section plus an end revision recap with Apply actions, micro-exercises (JD rewrite and Jesuthasan task decomposition), evidence cards, before and after Mermaid diagrams, and a collapsible color-coded HTML house style with a render-check script. Validated on XLRI Not Deeper Wider.
